name: SEBI Officer Grade A (Assistant Manager)

organization.name: Securities and Exchange Board of India

department: Securities and Exchange Board of India
summary: Officer entry into the market regulator in General, Legal, IT, Research, Official Language and Engineering streams. Two online phases and an interview. The 2025 drive had 110 posts (later raised).

status.note: 2025 cycle: notified 30 October 2025, Phase 1 on 10 January 2026, Phase 2 on 21 February 2026, final result in June 2026. The next notice is usually around October or November.

posts.name: Assistant Manager (Officer Grade A)
posts.responsibilities: Market supervision, investigation, legal and IT work.
posts.notes: Streams: General, Legal, IT, Research, Official Language, Engineering.

age.summary: Not over 30 on 30 September of the cycle year; relaxations of 5 (SC, ST), 3 (OBC) and 10 to 15 years (PwBD).

education.summary: A degree or postgraduate qualification as listed for each stream (for example a master's, LLB, CA/CFA or engineering degree).

eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

stages.name: Phase I (online screening)

papers.name: Paper 1: General awareness, English, quantitative aptitude, reasoning
papers.negative: One fourth of the question's marks

papers.name: Paper 2: Stream subject (General: commerce, accounts, finance, economics, company law)
papers.negative: One fourth of the question's marks

stages.notes: Cut-offs: 30% in Paper 1, 40% in Paper 2 and 40% aggregate.

selection.meritCalculation: Phase II 85% and interview 15%. Phase I only shortlists.

sections.subject: Typical areas
topics: General awareness, English, quantitative aptitude, reasoning
Securities markets, finance, economics, accounting, management
Stream subject paper

statistics.note: As notified; an addendum later raised General (56 to 77) and Research (4 to 8) posts.

salary.officialGrossNote: SEBI states gross pay at Mumbai at the start of the scale of about Rs 1,84,000 a month without accommodation (about Rs 1,43,000 with accommodation).

difficulty.rationale: About a hundred posts and a finance-heavy syllabus.

Variants cover the General, IT and Legal streams. Research, Official Language and Engineering (Electrical, Civil) streams are described only by the shared fields.
dataQuality.notes: Pattern, cut-offs, weightage, age and pay from the official 2025 notice.

education.summary: Master's degree or postgraduate diploma (minimum two years) in any discipline, or a bachelor's degree in law, or a bachelor's degree in engineering, or Chartered Accountant, Chartered Financial Analyst, Company Secretary or Cost Accountant.

eligibilityRules.notes: General stream: a plain bachelor's degree is not enough. Needs a master's or 2-year PG diploma, or a law or engineering degree, or CA / CFA / CS / Cost Accountant.

sections.subject: Paper 2: IT stream (indicative weightage in brackets)
topics: Database concepts (10): ER model, relational model, normal forms, indexing, transactions and concurrency control
SQL queries (10): joins, aggregate functions, set operations, nested queries
Programming concepts in Java, C or C++ (30): control flow, recursion, scope, parameter passing, OOP, exception handling
Data analytics languages, Python or R (10): regex, slicing, dataframes, file handling, charts
Algorithms for problem solving (10): tree and graph traversals, shortest paths, hashing, sorting, searching, greedy, dynamic programming, divide and conquer
Networking concepts (10): ISO/OSI stack, LAN technologies, TCP/UDP, IP, application layer protocols, firewalls
Information and cyber security concepts (10): cyber attacks, network security, authentication, CIA, network and systems audit
Data warehousing (5): extraction, cleaning, transformation, loading, data cube, data mart
Shell programming (5): shell scripting basics, variables, arguments, loops, basic UNIX commands

topics: English descriptive test of drafting skills

sections.subject: Paper 2: IT stream (indicative weightage in brackets)
topics: Algorithms (30): sorting, searching, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking, divide and conquer, pattern searching
Data structures (40): array, linked list, stack, queue, binary tree, binary search tree, heap, hashing, matrix, JSON objects
String manipulation (10): length, substring, regex, search
Object oriented programming (20): abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, inheritance

education.summary: Bachelor's degree in law from a recognised university or institute.

eligibility.experience: Not required. Desirable: two years of post-qualification experience as an advocate (including as an associate in an advocate's or solicitor's office or law firm) after enrolment under the Advocates Act, 1961. Up to 3.75 of the 15 interview marks are for relevant post-qualification experience.

eligibilityRules.notes: Legal stream: needs a bachelor's degree in law. Two years as an advocate is desirable, not required.
